items.optimistic_concurrency: revision_version plus SQLAlchemy atomic version column
items.http_contract: required If-Match on metadata, add, edit, move, classify and archive
items.validation_invalidation: all draft mutations clear validation and approval
items.approval_invalidation: publish returns APPROVAL_INVALIDATED after a post-approval mutation
items.sod_no_bypass: revision endpoints accept only their mapped duty roles; legacy admin grants do not bypass the duty filter
items.bootstrap_compatibility: the existing organization administrator receives Structure Editor only; approver and publisher remain explicit assignments
items.etag: GET and mutating revision responses expose the current version
items.postgres_trigger_fix: snapshot_json is compared as text; the inherited JSON equality failure is removed
items.frontend_conflict_message: This revision changed since you opened it. Reload the latest version before continuing.
items.snapshot_storage: full snapshot retained; Delta/Change Set not implemented
